== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on July 17, 2024.
** Was the 19th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK.
* Reached 4000 assists in the LCK on August 15, 2025.
** Was the 12th player to reach 4000 assists in the LCK.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x2 (Summer 2023, Summer 2024)
* LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x2 (Spring 2024, LCK 2025)
